resources.string: This is a live mirror, not a vault
Deleting media on your phone removes it from the next backup too. Never delete originals expecting to find them here. CryptSync exists to recover a lost or broken phone.
Backup paused: over your storage limit
The backup needs %1$s but your limit is %2$s. Lower the video or image bitrate on the Schedule tab, or raise the limit, then back up again.
CryptSync uses rclone\'s built in Drive access, so there is nothing to register. On a computer with rclone installed, run:
Sign in when the browser opens, then paste the whole token it prints below.
This password encrypts every backup. It is hashed locally, and you will need it to restore on a new phone or a PC.

Debug builds only. Paste an rclone remote body (type, url, keys) to point the backup at a self hosted server such as WebDAV or MinIO, so you can test without Google. The repository lands under a cryptsync path on that remote.

CryptSync backs up every file in the folders you choose. Photos and videos are re-encoded to shrink them, everything else is stored as is. With all files access it can also reach app folders under Android/media, such as WhatsApp\'s media and chat databases. It cannot reach private data under Android/data, so apps like Signal need their own exported backup.
If you only want photos and videos and would rather not grant all files access, allow access to your media instead. Android grants this for your whole photo and video library at once.
Needed to back up non-media files such as documents or app databases. It lets CryptSync read everything in the folders you choose.
Every file in these folders is backed up: photos and videos re-encoded to save space, everything else stored as is. Backing up non-media needs all files access above.
No locations yet. Add a folder with the buttons or the field below.

On, media is re-encoded smaller with the settings below. Off, photos and videos are stored as they are, which suits media another app already compressed. Everything still gets restic\'s lossless compression on upload.
Cap how large the backup can grow. A backup that would go over the cap pauses and does not upload. Lower the video and image bitrate above to fit more in. Leave empty for no limit.
Remote size unavailable, take a backup first or reconnect.
No limit set, backups run regardless of size.
Your backup is %1$s, over your %2$s limit. Lower the video and image bitrate on the Schedule tab, or raise the limit.
Paused, archive %1$s is over your %2$s limit
%1$s: no hardware encoder here, encoding may fail or be slow
Each key is a password that can unlock the repository. Old keys stay valid until you remove them. Removing the key you currently use will lock you out, so keep at least one you know.
Verify the backup in your cloud is complete and undamaged. If data chunks are missing, CryptSync lists the files that may be affected.
The backup in your cloud is damaged.

resources.string: The repository reports errors, see the details below.
Backup is intact, no problems found
Rebuild the index and run a backup. Files whose originals are still on this phone are re-uploaded.
Index rebuilt, a backup is running to re-upload recoverable files
Could not repair the repository, see the logs
Restore app data while the app is freshly installed and unopened, or clear that app\'s data (not just its cache) first. You can also restore the whole repository on a PC with restic.
No backup to restore yet. Run a backup first, then it shows up here.

This writes files back into the folders below. For a clean recovery these folders should be empty: on a phone that already has files or opened apps, restored files can overwrite or mix with what is there. Restore onto a fresh phone before opening the apps.
Could not read the folder list from the backup. Continue only if you know the target folders are empty.
Puts media back in your gallery, files back where they came from, and restores your settings.
Writes a plain copy into the app\'s own files, leaving your phone untouched.
%1$d could not be added to the gallery, see the logs
%1$d skipped, grant all files access to restore them
%1$d files could not be restored, they are missing from the backup
CryptSync keeps a live, encrypted copy of your media and chosen files in your own Google Drive, and can put it all back on a new phone. Is this a fresh start, or are you recovering from a backup?
Connect Drive, pick an encryption password, and choose what to back up.
New or wiped phone? Connect the Drive that holds your backup and put everything back, including your sources and settings.
Enter the encryption password you used on your old phone. It unlocks the backup so you can restore it.
This puts your media, files, and settings back on this phone. Media returns to your gallery.
Pick the folders to back up and grant access below. You can change any of this later on the Sources tab.
That password did not unlock the backup
A record of what you did in the app and how each action turned out. Keeps the most recent 200 entries.
No activity yet. Backups, restores, and security changes show up here.
A new key was added and set as the one in use
Backup requested, running in the background
Upload failed, it will retry automatically
Compression failed, it will retry automatically
Nothing to back up, no media or files selected
A running record of backups and errors, newest first. Keeps the most recent 500 entries.
No activity yet. Logs appear here once a backup or restore runs.
